html:
Exspelled is a unique blend of cozy life simulation and tower defense set in a magical fantasy world. You step into the role of a young witch named Aurora, who builds her own village from the ground up, transforming a small settlement into a thriving home. Gather resources, construct buildings, care for your villagers, and shape the world according to your vision.

But peaceful life is constantly challenged: when night falls, hostile creatures attack the village. Use Aurora’s powerful spells, build defensive structures, and develop clever strategies to protect your settlement from waves of enemies.

With its combination of relaxing village-building, charming fantasy atmosphere, and exciting tower defense combat, Exspelled offers an experience that is both cozy and challenging. Build your village, discover new magic, and help Aurora create a safe haven for everyone who lives there.
